items.html: By this you will understand what is said, that when ZON are equal together face to face, then the Netzah, Hod and Yesod of Aba and Ima are Mochin for ZA, and the NHY of YESHSUT are the Mochin that enter the head of the Nukva. You will also understand what is said, that when they were face to face, two aspects of Yaakov emerged: one in ZA and one in the Nukva, for the one from the Mochin of ZA is from Aba and Ima, and the second, which is from the Mochin of the Nukva, is from Israel Saba and Tevunah.
